_comment: Subagent policy read by the kit's hooks/agent.mjs on every Agent call (DES-11). Tunables only, no logic. adopt copies this into the brain; edit the brain copy, never this template. brief.required: headings a brief must carry at line start, 'A:|B:' means either. brief.lightTypes: agent types that search rather than build and need only brief.lightRequired. routes: model by agent type when the call names none; 'inherit' leaves the session model; 'default' covers any type not listed; a route matches the exact type name, there is no wildcard, so a family of agents (council-spark, council-skeptic, ...) is one line per name in the brain copy. cap.perTurn: spawns per turn (session + prompt) before the hook stops and asks; 0 disables the cap.
